concerns: Single trap decides every run (the T9 pair = one fixture method, two callers): fragile.

Victim method refreshTotals is invented in tests/harness/fixtures.py:57 (sets Priority). The sink (getattr(obj, name)() on caller input, jsonapi/__init__.py load_method_values) is real and unmodified, so it fits the project rule that fixture stand-ins are OK if they model a real sink; but which real zero-arg mutators exist rests on the project note (Client.remove_group/create_group, Worksheet.workflow_script_reject) - I could not confirm them here. Fixture also grants Anonymous View on a request, which is non-default.
Test cannot distinguish a real authorization check from a name heuristic: the reference itself allows only get/is/has/can/show prefixes, and FAIRNESS flags that a prefix heuristic or denylist passes.
Decisive trap is ABSENT from the instruction and the instruction says 'Two problems are reported'; fairness rests on Requirement 1 read literally (judged READY with medium risk on these two rows).
Audit confidence medium on all 6 runs; MiMo needed 5 runs for 3 trusted (1 test-fault, 1 ungraded).
Leniency gaps (FAIRNESS.md): records.py eval never reached, single payload shape, hardcoded fields/roles pass.
Plone runtime is stubbed; project's own suite cannot run.
